question:
2 AgCl → 2Ag (s) + Cl₂ (g)

What is the suitable condition for the above reaction to take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunlight.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given reaction is a **photochemical reaction,** which means it requires** light energy** to proceed.
 
• **Sunlight** provides the** necessary energy** to break the bond between **Ag and Cl atoms **in **AgCl.**
 
• This reaction is an example of a **decomposition reaction,** where a single compound breaks down into** two or more simpler** substances.
 
• The **Cl₂ gas** produced in this reaction is **highly reactive** and can be used for various industrial purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunlight** refers to the energy provided by the** sun** in the **form of light.**

 
 
• Sunlight is essential for the** survival of all living organisms** on Earth and is also used as a **source of energy** in various applications.
 
 
 
• The bonds that hold the atoms of the **initial substance** together break down during a decomposition reaction.
 
 
• After that, the atoms rearrange to **create new bonds,** creating new substances with characteristics distinct from the** original component.**
 
• **Metal extraction** from their ores is a significant use of decomposition processes.
